description:
Aggregates a project's captured errors into a table — the caller
names the filters, the groupings and the aggregations, and gets back the
columns and rows they asked for.

The project is mandatory and is checked against the caller's own org before it
scopes anything, so a project id belonging to someone else reads as absent
rather than as data.

field.description: Field is the column to test.

op.description: Op is how to test it: eq, neq or like.

value.description: Value is what to test it against.

aggregations.description: Aggregations are the measures to compute per group. Empty means a count.

filters.description:
Filters narrow the scan; each is a field, an operator (eq, neq, like) and
a value, and they combine with AND.

groupBy.description: GroupBy are the columns to group the rows by.

limit.description: Limit caps how many rows come back.

orderBy.description: OrderBy is the column or aggregation to sort the rows on.

period.description: Period is the window to read, relative to now — 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d.

project.description: Project is the project to read, as its id. Required.
